fullTextZH: 你好，今天是中国的除夕。
fullTextEN: Hello, today is China's New Year's Eve.
Tomorrow is China's New Year,
We also call it Spring Festival.
So today I want to talk about
1. Why do Chinese people celebrate Spring Festival,

fullTextZH: 2. 中国人过春节的时候做什么，
fullTextEN: 2. What do Chinese people do during Spring Festival,

fullTextZH: 3. 中国人过春节的时候吃什么。
fullTextEN: 3. What do Chinese people eat during Spring Festival.

fullTextZH: 第一个，为什么中国人过春节？
fullTextEN: First, why do Chinese people celebrate Spring Festival?

fullTextZH: 在中国，我们有两种日历。
fullTextEN: In China, we have two types of calendars.
One is called the Gregorian calendar,

fullTextZH: 也就是我们和大家都在用的公历，
fullTextEN: which is the Gregorian calendar we all use,
One is the Chinese lunar calendar.
The Gregorian and lunar calendars are different,

fullTextZH: 所以春节其实是农历的1月1号。
fullTextEN: so the Spring Festival is actually the 1st day of the lunar calendar.

fullTextZH: 所以我们也说农历新年。
fullTextEN: So we also call it the Lunar New Year.

fullTextZH: 一般来说，在中国我们也是看公历，
fullTextEN: Generally speaking, in China we also follow the Gregorian calendar,

fullTextZH: 可是在中国的传统节日，我们要看农历，
fullTextEN: but for traditional festivals in China, we follow the lunar calendar,
such as the Mid-Autumn Festival,
Dragon Boat Festival, Spring Festival,
we all follow the lunar calendar.
How long is the Spring Festival?
3 days? 5 days? 7 days?

fullTextZH: 都不对，一般来说春节有15天。
fullTextEN: None of those are correct, generally speaking, the Spring Festival lasts 15 days.

fullTextZH: 可是现在很多人要工作，
fullTextEN: But now many people have to work,
so companies won't give you 15 days,
Companies will give you 7 days.

fullTextZH: 春节的时候，大部分中国人回家。
fullTextEN: During the Spring Festival, most Chinese people go home.

fullTextZH: 所以呢，如果你坐中国的火车，
fullTextEN: So, if you take a Chinese train,

fullTextZH: 你会发现火车上很多很多人，
fullTextEN: you will find many, many people on the train,
This is what we call the Spring Festival travel rush.

fullTextZH: 第二个，春节的时候中国人做什么？
fullTextEN: Secondly, what do Chinese people do during the Spring Festival?
In China,

fullTextZH: 每个地方可能都有一点点不一样。
fullTextEN: every place might be a little different.

fullTextZH: 在我的老家，我们要打扫。
fullTextEN: In my hometown, we need to clean.

fullTextZH: 如果你的房子是木头房子，
fullTextEN: If your house is a wooden house,
you might need to wash the house.
Then we need to put up Spring Festival couplets,
some people also put up the character 'Fu'.
We will also buy
new clothes,
Because it's the New Year,

fullTextZH: 所以我们要穿新的衣服。
fullTextEN: so we need to wear new clothes.
We will also make food,
then go to many temples,
to honor ancestors, burn incense, and worship Buddha.
Then on New Year's Eve night,
which is tonight,
we will have New Year's Eve dinner,
which means the whole family together,
then eat many, many dishes.

fullTextZH: 吃完年夜饭以后，我们做什么？
fullTextEN: After finishing the New Year's Eve dinner, what do we do?
We will watch the Spring Festival Gala.
The Spring Festival Gala is a Chinese TV program,

fullTextZH: 我觉得是中国最大的电视节目。
fullTextEN: I think it's the biggest TV program in China.

fullTextZH: 现在很多人觉得春晚很无聊，
fullTextEN: Now many people think the Spring Festival Gala is boring,
but I watch it every year,

fullTextZH: 因为我觉得看春晚有过年的感觉。
fullTextEN: because I feel watching the Spring Festival Gala has the New Year feeling.
Some people also stay up all night.
In my hometown,
at midnight,
We want to set off firecrackers,
Everyone wants to set off firecrackers.
If you are not at home,

fullTextZH: 那可能你会打电话给你的爸爸妈妈，
fullTextEN: Then maybe you will call your parents,

fullTextZH: 然后告诉他们新年快乐。
fullTextEN: And tell them Happy New Year.
So these are before the Spring Festival,

fullTextZH: 然后到了春节，我们要做什么？
fullTextEN: Then when the Spring Festival arrives, what do we do?

fullTextZH: 春节的时候，一般来说我们要
fullTextEN: During the Spring Festival, generally speaking, we want to
pay New Year visits.
We want to go to relatives' homes,

fullTextZH: 去很多地方给他们拜年，
fullTextEN: Go to many places to pay them New Year visits,
Say Happy New Year.

fullTextZH: 一般来说，我们会给小孩子和老人红包，
fullTextEN: Generally speaking, we will give red envelopes to children and the elderly,
This is called 'yasuiqian' in Chinese.

fullTextZH: 在中国很多地方，你也可以看到舞龙、
fullTextEN: In many places in China, you can also see dragon dances,
Lion dances.

fullTextZH: 在我的老家，我们还有人，他们会唱戏。
fullTextEN: In my hometown, we also have people who will perform opera.

fullTextZH: 第三个，春节的时候我们吃什么？
fullTextEN: Thirdly, what do we eat during the Spring Festival?

fullTextZH: 当然，每个地方都不一样，
fullTextEN: Of course, every place is different,
Every family is also different.
In some places, they eat dumplings,
In some places, they eat rice cakes.

fullTextZH: 在我的老家，我们要做年糕，
fullTextEN: In my hometown, we make rice cakes,
then eat rice cakes.
We also eat red eggs,

fullTextZH: 因为你们知道，在中国的文化，
fullTextEN: because you know, in Chinese culture,
red is good,
it's auspicious.

fullTextZH: 所以在我的老家，我们会吃红蛋。
fullTextEN: So in my hometown, we eat red eggs.

fullTextZH: 在我小的时候，我去亲戚家，
fullTextEN: When I was young, I went to relatives' homes,
they gave me red eggs,
I disliked eating red eggs the most.

fullTextZH: 因为你吃了一个红蛋，你就饱了，
fullTextEN: Because after eating one red egg, you are full,
you can't eat anything else.

fullTextZH: 所以我从小到现在，我都不吃红蛋。
fullTextEN: So from childhood to now, I don't eat red eggs.
Generally speaking, at the New Year's Eve dinner,
we eat a lot of food,
there's chicken, duck, fish, and meat.

fullTextZH: 一般来说，我们会吃一道菜，
fullTextEN: Generally speaking, we eat a dish,
which is fish.

fullTextZH: 在中文，“鱼”听起来也是“余”，
fullTextEN: In Chinese, 'fish' sounds like 'surplus',
If we eat fish,
it sounds like 'year after year surplus (fish)',
a very good meaning.
So generally speaking,

fullTextZH: 每个家庭都会煮一个鱼。
fullTextEN: every family will cook a fish.
I am from Fujian, China,

fullTextZH: 在福建，我们很喜欢喝茶。
fullTextEN: In Fujian, we really like to drink tea.

fullTextZH: 如果客人来我的家，我会泡茶给他们喝，
fullTextEN: If guests come to my home, I will make tea for them to drink,
Then we make tea,
while eating snacks,
such as sunflower seeds,
such as peanuts,
then we chat.
Okay,

fullTextZH: 所以今天我说了为什么中国人过春节，
fullTextEN: So today I talked about why Chinese people celebrate the Spring Festival,

fullTextZH: 中国人过春节的时候做什么，
fullTextEN: what Chinese people do during the Spring Festival,
and what they eat.
How about you, do you celebrate the Spring Festival?
What traditions does your country have?
Leave a message to tell me.

fullTextZH: 所以最后祝你们春节快乐，
fullTextEN: So finally, I wish you a happy Spring Festival,
Wishing you prosperity.
Then we'll see you next time, bye.
